# Factur-X Engine

Self-hosted Docker API for technical Factur-X/ZUGFeRD CII and XRechnung UBL workflows.

## Trust boundaries

- `/v1/validate` reports executed and skipped validation layers.
- `/v1/extract` is a heuristic preview and always declares `suitable_for_automatic_import: false`.
- `/v1/serialize` is a strict schema v2 mapping or HTTP 422; it never repairs XML or invents values.
- Generation endpoints create artifacts but do not prove that every applicable validation layer ran.
- The caller retains supplier, duplicate, purchase-order, tax-policy and payment decisions.
- The software does not provide tax, accounting, legal, regulatory or security advice.

## Commercial and licensing status

All published repository code is MIT licensed. Factur-X Engine Intake is being tested in the same Docker image with free 30-day evaluation keys. The tested price is €299 excl. VAT, one-time, for one legal entity and internal use. There is no public paid checkout, SLA or paid support commitment.
